title: Warning not to disturb the earth

tellings.quote: don't when you disturb the earth, negative things happen.

plain: Brandon Fugal, the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange events, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about a warning someone gave him around 2016. As Fugal relays it, he was told that when you disturb the earth there, negative things happen, which would mean digging on the ranch could stir up trouble.
